Hi Bill,

I checked our side straight away. There is no order under (email hidden), so nothing was created on our system and no B30 is sitting in our queue for you. Your account with us shows zero orders.

What your bank is almost certainly showing is a pending authorization. When a checkout fails partway, the card network can still place a hold for the amount, and that hold drops off on its own, usually within three to five business days, with no money actually taken. It will look like a charge in your banking app until it does.

Because it is money and your card, I have put it in front of Abel and Georges with the amount and today's date so they can check the payment gateway from our end and void anything sitting there rather than wait for it to expire. They are on until 6pm Eastern and one of them will come back in this thread today to confirm either way.

One thing I would ask: please do not try the order again until you hear back, so we do not end up with two holds on your card. Once they confirm the first one is clear, I will make sure the B30 order goes through cleanly, and I will stay on this with you.

Sorry for the stumble at the last step after all this.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy
Thank You , looks like we are good to go on the order!

Hi Bill,

Good news, it did go through this time. Your order is Shop····, placed and paid, $1,009.43 in total, going to your (address hidden) address. It covers the Harlo B30 plus the Harlo OS Diagnostics and 3-Month RMA line.

The B30 ships November 30, 2026, which is the Batch 5 date you bought on, and that is the date held on your order. Nothing on it is waiting on a payment, so it is simply in the queue for that batch. You can watch that shipment making its way to our warehouse here, https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status, and bear in mind it can shift a little as stock moves between warehouses. Tracking goes to this same address the moment the box is labelled, so it is worth adding (email hidden) and (email hidden) to your contacts so none of it lands in junk.

Nothing is outstanding on the earlier hold either. Since the failed attempt was never cap····, that authorization drops off your statement on its own.

Thanks for the patience through all of this, Bill. It was a pleasure working through the detail with you, and I think the B30 on your solar battery is the right call. If you were happy with how we handled it, a word on Trustpilot would mean a lot to us, https://www.trustpilot.com/review/heliumdeploy.com. You are also very welcome in our Discord, https://discord.gg/Q2R5sA9Fsf, where JD and plenty of other owners are active and it is the fastest place to get setup help once the unit lands.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy
